description: Red River Flood is a series of datasets listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Manitoba | Gouvernement du Manitoba. The purpose of this feature layer is to provide the 2011 overland flooding boundary in the Red River Valley. This dataset shows the extent of peak overland flooding in the Red River Valley in 2011. Data is based on RADARSAT – 1 satellite imagery. Coverage: Government of Manitoba. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Manitoba | Gouvernement du Manitoba. Its tags are Manitoba, Manitoba Government, Red River, Flood, 2011. It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2025-02-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OpenMB Information and Data Use License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
